summary: Ternium S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, attaching the slide presentation used at its October 8, 2026 analyst-day meeting. The filing discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing condition; embedded image data contains no extractable deal terms. It is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report of investor-relations materials, equivalent to a US Form 8-K furnished under Item 7.01. No special-situation angle or risk-arb catalyst exists; watch only for any follow-on strategic announcement the presentation may foreshadow.
